name: Aparna Pradhan

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Aparna Pradhan writes in Hindi and English and also works as an artist. Trained in zoology, she contributes poetry and articles to literary publications; her essay on Awadhi cuisine appeared in the Journal of Asian Arts, Culture and Literature. Literary Warriors Group records the launch of her books नारी अस्मिता and त्रिआयामी at its 2023 New Delhi festival.

Her Kabita Live poems bring questions of dignity and belonging into direct speech. छुअन asks the reader to recognise a woman’s inward life beyond her body. आख़िर क्यूँ – परायेपन का दंश follows a woman from her childhood home to marriage, asking why neither place grants her an unquestioned sense of belonging.
